name: webverity
description: WebVerity Agent Skill Marketplace for automated website AI Discoverability, Machine Readability, and On-Site Engagement auditing for Adobe University Hackathon 2026.

skills.name: Audit Orchestrator
skills.description: Master entrypoint skill: coordinates the audit pipeline, schedules domain skills, normalizes findings, computes multi-factor severity, and emits the final audit report.

skills.name: Crawl & Render Audit
skills.description: Audits robots.txt AI bot exclusions, network transport headers, and client-side JavaScript rendering (CSR) content gaps.

skills.name: Structured Data & Entity Audit
skills.description: Validates schema.org JSON-LD syntax, entity disambiguation via sameAs links, and checks for contradictions between structured data and visible text.

skills.name: Freshness & Corroboration Audit
skills.description: Detects temporal staleness (outdated copyrights, stale modified dates) and cross-page factual contradictions across site pages.

skills.name: On-Site Engagement Audit
skills.description: Audits semantic heading hierarchies, above-the-fold value proposition orientation, buried answer discoverability, and contextual conversion paths.
